1.consolidated_definition: Recipiente de cocina, generalmente de metal, de forma circular, poco hondo y con mango largo, que sirve para guisar.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Cooking vessel, typically made of metal, with a circular shape, shallow depth, and long handle, used for stewing.
